en: A Song. A Psalm by David.

p.src: 1  My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

ja: は揺るがない。 私は
い、魂を尽くしてほめ歌う。
en: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
u.src: 1  My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

p.src: 2  Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

ja: ませ。 私は暁を呼び
en: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
u.src: 2  Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

p.src: 3  I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
u.src: 3  I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

p.src: 4  For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

ja: よりも高く、 あなたの真実は大空にまで
en: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
u.src: 4  For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

p.src: 5  Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

ja: く上げられてください。 あなたの
en: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
u.src: 5  Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

p.src: 6  That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

en: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
u.src: 6  That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

p.src: 7  God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

ja: られた。「わたしは勝ち誇ってシェケムを
en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
u.src: 7  God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

p.src: 8  Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

ja: ギレアデはわたしのもの。マナセもわたしのもの。 エフライムはわたしのかぶと。 ユダはわたしの王笏。
en: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
u.src: 8  Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

p.src: 9  Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

ja: げる。 ペリシテに向かって
en: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”
u.src: 9  Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

p.src: 10  Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

ja: へ導くだろうか。 誰が私をエドムへ
en: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
u.src: 10  Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

p.src: 11  Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

ja: けられたのは、あなたではないか。
en: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.
u.src: 11  Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

p.src: 12  Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

ja: 敵に立ち向かうため、私たちを
en: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
u.src: 12  Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

p.src: 13  Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

ja: ましく戦う。 神ご自身が、私たちの
en: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
u.src: 13  Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.
